description: FADE - Session Memory & Context Management for persistent Claude Code sessions
problemStatement: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code face a recurring problem: each session starts with zero context. There's no memory of what was learned, no awareness of project standards, no tracking of what's been completed, and no structured way to hand off between sessions. This means developers waste time re-explaining architecture every session, agents make the same mistakes repeatedly, multi-story features lose coherence, and there's no cumulative regression awareness. The result is fragmented, inefficient agentic development requiring constant human supervision to maintain continuity.
successMetrics: Session setup time drops from 2-5 minutes to under 30 seconds (context paste time = 0)
Zero repeat mistakes - errors corrected in previous sessions don't recur because learnings are automatically loaded
Session count per PRD approaches 1:1 story-to-session ratio (down from 8-10 sessions for a 5-story PRD)
Learnings persist across sessions without manual intervention
inScope: FADE.md structure and conventions (project standards, architecture refs, boundaries)
progress.md format and automatic updates when stories complete
learned.md format and automatic append on session exit
Session bootstrap - Claude loads context automatically via fade run
Session exit discipline - Claude writes progress + learnings before signaling done
fade init CLI command to scaffold structure
fade run CLI command to inject context and execute
outOfScope: Heavy runtime dependencies (must stay bash + jq + Claude CLI)

userStories.title: fade init scaffolds structure
userStories.description: As a developer starting a new project, I want fade init to create FADE.md, progress.md, learned.md templates so that I can start with working structure in 30 seconds.
acceptanceCriteria: Running fade init in project root creates FADE.md, progress.md, learned.md if they don't exist
Files contain clear template sections with placeholder text/examples
Command completes in under 5 seconds
Running fade init when files exist doesn't overwrite (safe to re-run)
Success message indicates which files were created
Script runs without errors on macOS (shellcheck passes)

userStories.title: FADE.md template and conventions
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a documented FADE.md format so that I know what to put in each section and Claude knows how to interpret it.
acceptanceCriteria: FADE.md template includes sections: Project Overview, Coding Standards, Architecture References, Off-Limits Modules, Session Boundaries
Each section has inline documentation explaining what belongs there
Template references where to link standards docs (e.g., TypeScript guide, API patterns)
Format is markdown with clear heading hierarchy
Examples provided for at least 2 sections (e.g., sample off-limits warning, sample architecture reference)

userStories.title: fade run loads context files
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade run to automatically inject FADE.md + progress.md + learned.md into Claude Code's context so that I never manually paste context again.
acceptanceCriteria: Running fade run concatenates FADE.md, progress.md, learned.md into Claude Code session prompt
Context injection happens before Claude starts processing (Claude sees all files from first message)
Missing files are handled gracefully (warning but doesn't fail - allows partial setup)
Claude Code session starts within 10 seconds of fade run execution
Bash script uses Claude CLI documented methods for context injection
Script runs without errors on macOS (shellcheck passes)

userStories.title: Claude updates progress.md and learned.md on exit
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Claude to mark the story complete in progress.md AND append any discoveries to learned.md before signaling done, so that session state is captured automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: When Claude completes a user story, it appends completion entry to progress.md with timestamp and story ID
Any new learnings discovered during session are appended to learned.md with context (what was learned, why it matters)
Updates happen before Claude signals 'done' or exits session
Format for progress.md entries is consistent: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM - US-XXX: Story title - COMPLETE
Format for learned.md entries includes date, discovery, and relevance
Claude does not overwrite existing entries, only appends

technicalNotes: Must work with Claude Code CLI as execution engine. Stack limited to bash + jq + Claude CLI (no heavy dependencies). All state stored as markdown/JSON in repo (Git-friendly). Reuses Ralph's prd.json format and bash loop pattern. Reference Claude Code CLI docs for context injection and exit detection: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code
openQuestions: Does Claude Code CLI support pre-session context injection via file concatenation, or do we need to simulate initial prompt?
What's the signal for 'session complete' - does Claude explicitly exit, or do we detect inactivity?
Should learned.md entries be timestamped or session-tagged for future retrieval?
